title: Dataflow & wafer-scale
summary: Lay the program out across the chip and keep weights where the work happens.

links.why: map the program onto the chip

ideas.how: weights stay where the work happens, spread across the chip
wafer-scale chips go back to one giant piece of silicon, to keep data on the chip

tradeoffs.how: keeping the weights on chip is fastest, if they fit
wafer-scale chips choose the other end: one piece of silicon, with spares
